snippet.title: Cast N Chill | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Hold the line for a cosy, idle fishing game packed with stunning pixel art vistas, furry companions and legendary catches. Frosty Games Fest brings you an all-new look at one of the 14 serene fishing spots set to appear in Cast n Chill when it launches in full on June 16. 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3483740/Cast_n_Chill/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
